required_fixes: Isolate CL-PASSTHROUGH origin framing: spec.json measurement_validity #35 and prereg 4.3 fix V1 require use_chunked=True only for CHUNKED-PASSTHROUGH and CHUNKED-CACHED; run_experiment.py:626 sets origin_use_chunked=True for all origins including CL-PASSTHROUGH cells, so C_CONTENT_LENGTH_REGRESSION is not an independent Content-Length origin baseline but a chunked-origin->Content-Length-proxy path. Fix: start origin with use_chunked=False for CL-PASSTHROUGH and True only for chunked configs, or document the contamination and run an independent CL-origin regression cell.

Exercise multi-chunk reassembly: all observed compressed body_sizes are 70-176 bytes (result.json per_cell body_sizes max 176) while proxy and origin chunk_size is hard-coded 1024 (run_experiment.py:265/365/414). Every response fits in a single chunk plus terminator, so chunk boundaries never split brotli payload. The hypothesized failure mode 'chunk boundaries corrupt brotli multi-byte symbols' is untested. Fix: either lower chunk_size to e.g., 32-64 bytes or generate incompressible/less-compressible payloads so compressed size exceeds chunk_size, and log observed chunk counts per response.

Provide direct header evidence for proxy HIT path: V2 double-header fix is verified only by code inspection (run_experiment.py:360-373 sends only Transfer-Encoding on HIT for chunked configs). No raw observation in result.json captures actual HIT response headers (Transfer-Encoding presence and absence of Content-Length) for CHUNKED-CACHED HIT. Fix: capture and persist per-request response headers for HIT vs MISS and assert HIT has Transfer-Encoding: chunked and no Content-Length.

validity_findings.finding: CL-PASSTHROUGH origin incorrectly serves chunked. Frozen spec measurement_validity #35 and prereg 4.2/4.3 require origin Content-Length for CL-PASSTHROUGH and chunked only for CHUNKED configs. Code starts every origin with use_chunked=True (run_experiment.py:626 comment 'All origins serve chunked'), verified by result.json body_sizes showing same compressed sizes across configs but header verification only tests fresh servers with chunked=True. The positive control C_CONTENT_LENGTH_REGRESSION therefore tests chunked-origin->CL-proxy, not CL-origin->CL-proxy.

validity_findings.impact: C_CONTENT_LENGTH_REGRESSION is not an independent regression control. It still passes at 0.5, confirming proxy can transcode chunked upstream to Content-Length downstream, but it cannot isolate proxy drift from origin framing. Primary chunked test remains valid; control must be re-run with isolated CL origin before using CL regression to attribute effects.

validity_findings.finding: Chunked TE exercised only as single-chunk framing. Compressed body_sizes are 70-176 bytes across all 27 cells (result.json per_cell body_sizes mean 70-176, max 176) while origin and proxy chunk_size is 1024 bytes (run_experiment.py:265, 365, 414). Brotli quality 6 on repetitive padded JSON/HTML/XML compresses 1KB/10KB/100KB uncompressed to <176 bytes, so each response is sent as one data chunk plus 0 terminator. No chunk boundary splits the brotli stream.
validity_findings.evidence: research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-35434773328/result.json metrics.per_cell body_sizes max 176.0 across 27 cells; research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-35434773328/run_experiment.py:265 chunk_size=1024 origin, 365/414 proxy HIT/MISS; provenance.json brotli_quality 6, payload_sizes 1KB/10KB/100KB but body_sizes 70-176 compressed
validity_findings.impact: Hypothesized failure mode 'chunk boundaries split brotli multi-byte symbols' cannot be falsified by this run. Evidence supports transparency of chunked reassembly only for single-chunk payloads via HTTPConnection.read() de-chunking. Claim ceiling must be bounded to single-chunk payloads; multi-chunk reassembly remains untested.

claim_ceiling: Iterative decompression (brotli->gzip->identity loop max_depth=5) preserves decompressed body-only discrimination at 0.5 (threshold >=0.3) through chunked TE when BOTH upstream origin->proxy and downstream proxy->client legs are chunked on localhost mock infrastructure, but only for single-chunk payloads (compressed body 70-176 bytes < chunk_size 1024) in PASSTHROUGH and AUTH-AWARE CACHED modes (URL+Accept-Encoding+Authorization, Cache-Control: private, Vary: Authorization). Validated for Flask/stdlib mock OAuth2 origin brotli quality 6 deterministic, 3 content types (JSON/HTML/XML) x3 sizes (1KB/10KB/100KB uncompressed, highly compressible to <176 bytes) x4 auth states (no_auth, valid_token HS256, expired_token HS256, invalid_token) x5 reps seed 44 jitter 50-150ms, N=540, Python 3.12.14, brotli 1.2.0, 0 decompression errors, determinism 72/72 match, B-RANDOM 0.0. CL-PASSTHROUGH regression is contaminated (origin was also chunked, V1) so independent Content-Length origin baseline not re-verified. Multi-chunk reassembly where a brotli stream is split across chunks, real CDN infrastructure (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai), Accept-Encoding negotiation, multi-layer brotli, binary content, and production-scale concurrency remain untested.
